text: A temporary endeavour undertaken to create a unique product or service is a

explanation: A project is temporary and produces a unique deliverable.

text: The first phase of the project life cycle is

explanation: Initiation defines the project and its objectives first.

text: The person responsible for delivering the project objectives is the project
subject: Project Management
explanation: The project manager leads planning and execution to meet objectives.

text: A project is a continuous ongoing operation like production
subject: Project Management
explanation: A project is temporary and unique unlike ongoing operations.

text: List the phases of the project life cycle
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Initiation planning execution monitoring and control and closure.
explanation: These five phases take a project from idea to completion.

text: Explain the characteristics of a project
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: A project has defined objectives a fixed duration unique output limited resources and cross functional teamwork and progresses through a life cycle.
explanation: Cover the temporary unique and resource bound nature of projects.

text: The statement of what the project will deliver is the project
subject: Project Management
explanation: Scope defines the deliverables and boundaries of the project.

text: Breaking a project into smaller manageable parts is the work breakdown
subject: Project Management
explanation: The work breakdown structure decomposes work into tasks.

text: Project planning is the first and most important function of project management
subject: Project Management
explanation: Planning sets objectives scope schedule and resources for the project.

text: List the steps in project planning
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Defining objectives identifying activities sequencing estimating resources and scheduling.
explanation: These steps build the project plan.

text: Explain the importance of project planning
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Planning clarifies objectives allocates resources sets the schedule and provides the baseline for control reducing uncertainty and risk.
explanation: Cover clarity resource allocation and control baseline.

text: The network technique used to schedule project activities is
subject: Project Management
options: CPM and PERT|Ratio analysis|Break even analysis|Regression
explanation: CPM and PERT are network techniques for scheduling projects.

text: The longest path of activities through a project network is the
subject: Project Management
explanation: The critical path determines the shortest project completion time.

text: PERT is used when activity durations are certain while CPM is used when they are uncertain
subject: Project Management
explanation: PERT handles uncertain durations while CPM uses deterministic durations.

text: List the differences between CPM and PERT
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: CPM is activity oriented with deterministic times while PERT is event oriented with probabilistic time estimates.
explanation: The difference lies in orientation and certainty of durations.

text: Explain the steps in drawing a project network
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: A network is built by listing activities determining their sequence and dependencies drawing nodes and arrows and then computing earliest and latest times.
explanation: Cover activity listing sequencing and time computation.

text: The estimation and control of project costs is project
subject: Project Management
explanation: Project costing estimates and controls the money spent on a project.

text: The document that details the financial plan of a project is the project
subject: Project Management
explanation: The project budget allocates funds across activities and time.

text: Cost overrun occurs when actual cost exceeds the budget
subject: Project Management
explanation: Cost overrun is spending more than the planned budget.

text: List the sources of project finance
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Equity debt term loans grants and internal accruals.
explanation: These sources provide capital for project investment.

text: Explain the techniques of project cost estimation
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Cost estimation uses analogous parametric and bottom up methods ranging from quick historical estimates to detailed activity by activity costing.
explanation: Describe each technique and when it is used.

text: The process of tracking project progress against the plan is
subject: Project Management
explanation: Monitoring tracks progress against the project plan.

text: The chance of an event that could harm the project is a project
subject: Project Management
explanation: Project risk is uncertainty that may affect objectives.

text: Risk management aims to eliminate all risks from a project
subject: Project Management
explanation: Risk cannot be eliminated only identified assessed and managed.

text: List the steps in project control
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Setting standards measuring performance comparing with standards and taking corrective action.
explanation: This control cycle keeps the project on track.

text: Explain the process of project risk management
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Risk management identifies risks assesses their likelihood and impact develops responses and monitors them throughout the project.
explanation: Trace risk identification assessment response and monitoring.

text: The structure that brings people from different functions to work on a project is a
subject: Project Management
explanation: A matrix organisation combines functional and project authority.

text: The formal completion and handover of the project is project
subject: Project Management
explanation: Project closure completes the work and hands over the deliverable.

text: A project can be terminated early if its objectives are no longer viable
subject: Project Management
explanation: Projects may end early due to failure or changed objectives.

text: List the types of project organisation
subject: Project Management
explanation: These structures differ in where project authority resides.

text: Explain the responsibilities of a project manager
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: The project manager plans organises leads and controls the project managing scope time cost quality risk and the team to meet objectives.
explanation: Cover planning leadership and control responsibilities.

text: Assertion: The critical path has zero float. Reason: Any delay on the critical path delays the whole project
subject: Project Management
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion|Both are true but reason does not explain assertion|Assertion is true but reason is false|Assertion is false but reason is true
explanation: Critical activities have no slack so their delay extends the project.

text: Match the concept to its meaning
subject: Project Management
options: Float - spare time in an activity|Critical path - shortest path|Network - a budget|Milestone - a resource
explanation: Float is spare time while the critical path is the longest path.

text: The slack time available in a non critical activity is called float
subject: Project Management
explanation: Float is the spare time an activity can be delayed without delaying the project.

text: Explain the meaning and importance of feasibility analysis of a project
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Feasibility analysis assesses technical economic financial and social viability before commitment to avoid investing in unworkable projects.
explanation: Cover the dimensions of feasibility and its importance.

text: Read the case: A construction project is falling behind schedule because two activities on the critical path are delayed. Explain the consequence and a corrective measure
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Delays on the critical path delay the whole project. The manager should crash the critical activities by adding resources to shorten their duration.
explanation: Apply critical path logic and propose crashing.

text: Read the case: A software project has a fixed deadline and a team with limited skills in a new technology. Identify the risk and suggest a mitigation
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: The risk is skill shortage causing schedule slippage. The manager should provide training or hire specialists early to mitigate it.
explanation: Identify the skill risk and propose early mitigation.

text: A project has three activities of duration 4 6 and 8 days that must run in sequence. The total project duration is
subject: Project Management
explanation: Sequential activities sum to 4 plus 6 plus 8 which equals 18 days.

text: Explain the causes of project failure
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Projects fail due to poor planning unclear objectives inadequate resources poor communication and weak risk management.
explanation: Cover the planning and management causes of failure.

text: The process of closing out all project activities is project termination
subject: Project Management
explanation: Termination completes and closes the project formally.

text: Explain the steps in project termination
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Termination involves completing remaining work handing over deliverables releasing resources documenting lessons and closing accounts.
explanation: Cover handover resource release and documentation.

text: List the benefits of using CPM and PERT
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Better planning identifying the critical path resource optimisation and progress control.
explanation: These benefits improve scheduling and control.

text: Explain the concept and types of project appraisal
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Project appraisal evaluates technical economic financial and managerial feasibility using methods like net present value and internal rate of return.
explanation: Cover the appraisal dimensions and financial techniques.

text: The expected time in PERT is calculated from optimistic pessimistic and most likely times
subject: Project Management
explanation: PERT computes expected time as a weighted average of the three estimates.

text: Explain the importance of project organisation structure
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: The organisation structure defines authority and coordination affecting communication and control so the right structure improves project delivery.
explanation: Link structure to authority communication and control.

text: The estimate of costs based on a similar past project is
subject: Project Management
explanation: Analogous estimating uses historical project data for a quick estimate.

text: Explain the tools used for project monitoring
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Monitoring uses Gantt charts network diagrams milestone reports and earned value analysis to track progress and detect deviations.
explanation: Describe each tool and its use in tracking.

text: A milestone is a significant point or event in a project schedule
subject: Project Management
explanation: Milestones mark important events with zero duration in a schedule.

text: Explain the importance of project scheduling
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Scheduling sequences activities sets timelines allocates resources and provides the basis for monitoring and controlling project progress.
explanation: Cover sequencing timelines and control baseline.

text: Explain the concept and importance of project team building
subject: Project Management
correctAnswer: Team building develops cooperation trust and shared goals among project members improving communication and performance.
explanation: Cover cooperation communication and performance benefits.
